minutes.headline: Select Board waived its right of first refusal, clearing the way for a six-lot subdivision on West Townsend Road.
minutes.summary: The Select Board waived its right of first refusal on a 13-acre Chapter 61B property, opening the way for a six-lot subdivision, and heard the town manager describe near-simultaneous departures of the payroll/benefits administrator, assistant accountant, and finance director, with a new finance director's offer accepted. The board also reviewed fall/annual Town Meeting warrant articles including a roof estimate for the TCP building, declined to pursue an article transferring additional Chapter 70 aid to schools, and deferred voting on a three-year MART Council on Aging contract pending clarification of an insurance reimbursement change.

what_happened.line: The Select Board waived its right of first refusal on a Chapter 61B property, clearing the way for a six-lot subdivision on West Townsend Road.
The town manager described near-simultaneous departures of the payroll/benefits administrator, assistant accountant, and finance director.
An offer for the finance director position was extended and accepted; the new hire's employment agreement goes to the board next meeting.
The board declined to pursue a warrant article transferring additional Chapter 70 aid to schools, with the town manager citing no stated need.
The board deferred voting on a multi-year Council on Aging services contract pending clarification of a changed insurance reimbursement term.

why_it_matters: Waiving the town's refusal right on the 61B parcel removes a municipal option to acquire or restrict the land, opening it to a private six-lot subdivision instead.
Three departures in the finance office at once touches who processes payroll, benefits, and the town's books during an active budget season.
Declining the Chapter 70 transfer article means no extra state school aid will be routed to the district at fall Town Meeting unless the board reconsiders.
watch_next: Next Select Board meeting: the new finance director's employment agreement and compiled feedback on the master plan steering committee draft.
Council on Aging/MART contract vote, pending clarification of the insurance reimbursement change before next Tuesday's deadline.
